assets.raw_headers:
# Cloudflare Pages headers (copied to out/_headers).
# Long-cache immutable build assets.
/_next/static/*
  Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable

# Baseline security headers.
/*
  X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
  Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin
assets.raw_redirects:
# Cloudflare Pages redirects. This file is copied to the deploy root (out/_redirects).
# Root → default locale (edge redirect, no JS needed).
#
# Kept as 302 (not 301) on purpose: "/" is a language-neutral entry point for a
# 10-language site. A permanent 301 is cached hard by browsers and would block ever
# adding Accept-Language / geo routing at the root without fighting stale caches.
# SEO cost is nil — /en/ is the declared hreflang x-default and every locale home
# cross-links via hreflang, so crawlers resolve the canonical set correctly. Reviewed
# 2026-08-26; revisit only if the English default is made permanent.
/            /en/    302

# (Later) if ktrip.kr is added as a second custom domain pointing here,
# keep everything on the canonical .com — handled via Cloudflare Redirect Rules,
# not this file. See DEPLOY.md §4.
